parsed.rationale: Both `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 38 in HLSPlayerMessages.swift) and `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 42 in RadioPlayerMessages.swift) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Because the implementations are identical and neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift fix is to introduce (or extend) a shared message protocol — e.g., `PlayerMessage` — and provide a single default implementation of `makeNotification()` in a protocol extension, eliminating the per-type copies in both files.
